{{Quote|noquote=1|<nowiki></nowiki>''[VVEEOWR]<br />"''Oh, sir, we're done for! They've set Simoomian sensory hounds on our trail!|C-3PO mistakes the sound of an energy drill for Simoomian sensory hounds|<ref name="Splinter of the Mind's Eye 1">[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye 1|''Splinter of the Mind's Eye'' 1]]</ref>}}
The '''Simoomian sensory hound'''<ref name="Splinter of the Mind's Eye 1" /> was a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of six-[[Limb/Legends|legged]] [[Canine/Legends|canid]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Simoom (planet)|Simoom]]. Renowned for their preternatural [[Eye/Legends|eyesight]], [[Ear/Legends|hearing]], and sense of [[Nose/Legends|smell]], they were domesticated by herders, and most [[Noble/Legends|noble]] estates of the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex]] and [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex]] [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] had a pack of sensory hounds for [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] and security.<ref name="TEA" />

While on the planet [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]]<ref name="Splinter of the Mind's Eye 1" /> in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="The Essential Reader's Companion">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of the novel ''[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye]]'' to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]]. As it is an adaptation of part of the novel, [[Splinter of the Mind's Eye 1|''Splinter of the Mind's Eye'' 1]] must also take place in 2 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]].</ref> the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] mistook<ref name="Splinter of the Mind's Eye 1" /> the violent, howling sound<ref name="Splinter of the Mind's Eye">''[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye]]''</ref> of an [[Energy mining/Legends|energy mining]] [[Energy drill|drill]] for that of Simoomian sensory hounds, and assumed that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] had set a pack of them on the trail of [[Gender/Legends|himself]] and fellow [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] members [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]].<ref name="Splinter of the Mind's Eye 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Simoomian sensory hound was first mentioned in the [[Splinter of the Mind's Eye 1|first issue]] of [[Dark Horse Comics]]' [[Star Wars: Splinter of the Mind's Eye (comic series)|adaptation]] of ''[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye]]'', which was written by [[Terry Austin]] and illustrated by [[Chris Sprouse]]<ref name="Splinter of the Mind's Eye 1" /> and released on [[December 26]], [[1995]].<ref name="Splinter of the Mind's Eye 1 release date">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54554/star_wars_splinter_of_the_minds_eye_1995_1|text=Star Wars: Splinter of the Mind's Eye (1995) #1}}</ref>
